f_01KXD2GW32HQ3SKFYG3VWZ3C2W.subject: job_total_estimate
f_01KXD2GW32HQ3SKFYG3VWZ3C2W.content: The Simons Addition job has a grand total estimate of $100,778.92: $45,167.59 labor, $52,171.33 materials, $3,440.00 equipment.

f_01KXD2GW32BQF0GC2DHK80MV0H.subject: job_labor_hours_total
f_01KXD2GW32BQF0GC2DHK80MV0H.content: The cost breakdown totals 1,287 labor hours across all 16 sections.

f_01KXD2GW32CZ3G8GSTGZHTG82G.subject: addition_footprint_sf
f_01KXD2GW32CZ3G8GSTGZHTG82G.content: The breakdown records an overall footprint of 789 square feet at 8-foot ceiling height.

f_01KXD2GW32D8CS6H01FFSTHVB6.subject: addition_dimensions_and_program
f_01KXD2GW32D8CS6H01FFSTHVB6.content: The addition is approximately 30'x10', two stories, adding basement-level storage and a second-floor primary bedroom, master bathroom, and walk-in closet.

f_01KXD2GW33WXY1H1K6X5GVFFP3.subject: septic_tdec_required
f_01KXD2GW33WXY1H1K6X5GVFFP3.content: Scope explicitly requires a TDEC septic inspection to evaluate relocation options (new tank/leach field or grinder pump to sewer); septic costs are excluded from the contract as a change order item.

f_01KXD2GW33S58PQ974VXDFG8N8.subject: roof_pitch_transition
f_01KXD2GW33S58PQ974VXDFG8N8.content: The new gable roof is approximately 3/12 pitch tying into the existing 6/12 pitch; truss vs. rafter framing is explicitly TBD in the design phase.

f_01KXD2GW33E249G1AVG05TE1CF.subject: lvl_beam_spec
f_01KXD2GW33E249G1AVG05TE1CF.content: A 3-ply 14" LVL beam spanning approximately 15'-6" is included to open an existing load-bearing wall; temporary shoring is in scope.

f_01KXD2GW33N0C2KBC4HEHDMAVV.subject: electrical_subpanel_scope
f_01KXD2GW33N0C2KBC4HEHDMAVV.content: Scope includes a new 100-amp subpanel with full rough-in and trim-out, 12 recessed lights, a dedicated 120V/30A elevator circuit, and GFCI/AFCI protection throughout.

f_01KXD2GW33AQNR5SWK0V3KHC2T.subject: hvac_type
f_01KXD2GW33AQNR5SWK0V3KHC2T.content: HVAC scope is a mini-split system per the breakdown section 'HVAC – Mini Split, Tankless WH & Relocations'; existing heat pump and electrical disconnect relocation is also in scope.

f_01KXD2GW330S9JZ23AXWFAVT1B.subject: water_heater_scope_conflict
f_01KXD2GW330S9JZ23AXWFAVT1B.content: Scope document states 'extend existing gas water heater vent through new roof' (no new tank), but the breakdown is titled 'Incl. Tankless WH Option' with $5,140 in materials allocated to the HVAC/WH section — an unresolved contradiction.

f_01KXD2GW33F1TDFAWKDS76ANS5.subject: elevator_shaft_framed
f_01KXD2GW33F1TDFAWKDS76ANS5.content: A 4'x4' future elevator shaft is framed in scope; the elevator system itself is excluded from the contract.

f_01KXD2GW339C3M9CD3P76Q6NTT.subject: window_count
f_01KXD2GW339C3M9CD3P76Q6NTT.content: Scope includes four windows — three 36"x60" and one transom — plus one new exterior door.

f_01KXD2GW3395H3PRQVE674T53F.subject: hall_bath_mod_section
f_01KXD2GW3395H3PRQVE674T53F.content: The breakdown includes 'Existing Hall Bath Mod, Bedroom Remodel & Closeout' with $2,484.80 labor, -$4,199.00 materials, and a net section total of -$1,714.20 across 72 labor hours — a retrofit section not named in the addition objective.

f_01KXD2GW33H29B06406R98WD9K.subject: drawings_designer
f_01KXD2GW33H29B06406R98WD9K.content: Architectural drawings (sheets A-01 and A-02, scale 1/4"=1'-0") are by Francisco Guerrero, NCIDQ (Interior Architect), and show the addition extending off the right/rear of the existing brick home with new lap siding and a multi-level deck.

f_01KXD2GW3376T6RHQTXZWBG80P.subject: addition_exterior_spec
f_01KXD2GW3376T6RHQTXZWBG80P.content: Addition exterior uses vinyl siding to match existing (exact match not guaranteed); drawings call out 'ADD BRICK TO MATCH EXISTING' at the base of the addition.

f_01KXD2GW33C27PFSPYZ06P5SDG.subject: customer_brother
f_01KXD2GW33C27PFSPYZ06P5SDG.content: Customer John Simons has a brother named Andrew.
